│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│    "vulnerability_type": "Integer underflow leading to out‑of‑bounds write (buffer overflow)",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│    **"cwe_id"**: "CWE-190 (Integer Overflow or Wraparound) / CWE-125 (Out‑of‑bounds Write)",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│    "vulnerable_region": "Lines 4492‑4498 (function `TrioString_max` / `trio_print_*` implementation):\n```c\n    assert(VALID(buffer));\n    assert(VALID(format));\n\n    buf_len = trio_length(buffer);\n    buffer = &buffer[buf_len];\n    status =\n        TrioFormat(&buffer, max - 1 - buf_len,\n                    TrioOutStreamStringMax,   │
│  format, args, NULL, NULL);\n    *buffer = NIL;\n    return status;\n```\nThe subtraction `max - 1 - buf_len` is performed without first ensuring that `buf_len < max`. If `buf_len` is equal to or larger than `max`, the subtraction underflows (wraps) to a very large unsigned value, which is then supplied as the `max` argument to              │
│  `TrioFormat`. Inside `TrioFormat` this value is used as the destination size for writes, allowing an uncontrolled write past the end of the caller‑supplied buffer.",                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│    "root_cause_explanation": "The code trusts that the original buffer already contains a terminating NUL within the supplied `max` limit. It uses `trio_length(buffer)` to obtain the current length, but does **not** verify that this length is smaller than `max`. The subsequent expression `max - 1 - buf_len` therefore can underflow when      │
│  `buf_len >= max`. The underflow yields a huge positive length that is later used as a write limit, resulting in an out‑of‑bounds write to the caller’s buffer.\n\nThis is a classic integer‑underflow‑caused buffer overflow.\n",                                                                                                                     │
│    "input_to_sink_flow": "User‑controlled or attacker‑influenced data → `buffer` argument (output buffer) and `max` (its size) passed to `trio_print_*` / `TrioOutStreamStringMax`. The function computes `buf_len = trio_length(buffer)` (reads the existing content) and then calculates `max - 1 - buf_len` without a bound check. The              │
│  under‑flowed result is passed as the `max` parameter to `TrioFormat`, which writes formatted data into `buffer`. The malformed size allows writing past the end of `buffer`.\n",                                                                                                                                                                      │
│    "security_impact": "Arbitrary memory write beyond the allocated output buffer. This can corrupt adjacent heap or stack data, cause crashes, or be leveraged for remote code execution depending on the surrounding memory layout.",                                                                                                                 │
│    "severity": "HIGH",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│    "tool_evidence": [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      "CodeQL: `cpp/overflow-and-underflow` – flagged the subtraction `max - 1 - buf_len` as a potential integer underflow without prior bounds check.",                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      "CodeQL: `cpp/array-index-out-of-bounds` – traced the under‑flowed value as being used as a size argument in `TrioFormat`, which subsequently writes to `buffer` beyond its allocated range.",                                                                                                                                                    │
│      "Planner hints – identified the same subtraction at line 4498 as a high‑confidence issue."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * QUALIFIERS:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * Numbers = d,i,o,u,x,X                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│   * Float = a,A,e,E,f,F,g,G                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   * String = s                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   * Char = c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * 9$ Position                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      Use the 9th parameter. 9 can be any number between 1 and                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *      the maximal argument                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * 9 Width                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *      Set width to 9. 9 can be any number, but must not be postfixed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│   *      by '$'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * h  Short                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      (unsigned) short int                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * hh Short short                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      (unsigned) char                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * l  Long                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      (unsigned) long int                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│   *    String:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   *      as the S specifier                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *    Char:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│   *      as the C specifier                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * ll Long Long                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      (unsigned) long long int                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * L  Long Double                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   *    Float                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│   *      long double                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * #  Alternative                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   *    Float:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   *      Decimal-point is always present                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   *    String:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   *      non-printable characters are handled as \number                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   *    Spacing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * +  Sign                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * -  Alignment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * .  Precision                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * *  Parameter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *    print: use parameter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *    scan: no parameter (ignore)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * q  Quad                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * Z  size_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * w  Widechar                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * '  Thousands/quote                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      Integer part grouped in thousands                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│   *    Binary numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│   *      Number grouped in nibbles (4 bits)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│   *    String:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│   *      Quoted string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * j  intmax_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│   * z  size_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │

Sticky                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   * @  Parameter (for both print and scan)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * I  n-bit Integer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│   *    Numbers:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│   *      The following options exists                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│   *        I8  = 8-bit integer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │

│  /* Parameters */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  typedef struct                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          /* An indication of which entry in the data union is used */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          int type;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          /* The flags */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │

│          int width;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│          int precision;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│          int base;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│          int baseSpecifier;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          /* The size for the variable size qualifier */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          int varsize;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          /* Offset of the first character of the specifier */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          int beginOffset;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          /* Offset of the first character after the specifier */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │

│          /* The data from the argument list */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│                  trio_wchar_t* wstring;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  trio_pointer_t pointer;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  union {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                          trio_intmax_t as_signed;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                          trio_uintmax_t as_unsigned;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  } number;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  #if TRIO_FEATURE_FLOAT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  double doubleNumber;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  double* doublePointer;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│                  trio_long_double_t* longdoublePointer;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  int errorNumber;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │

│  /* General trio "class" */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  typedef struct _trio_class_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The function to write characters to a stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          void(*OutStream) TRIO_PROTO((struct _trio_class_t*, int));                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The function to read characters from a stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          void(*InStream) TRIO_PROTO((struct _trio_class_t*, int*));                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The function to undo read characters from a stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          void(*UndoStream) TRIO_PROTO((struct _trio_class_t*));                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The current location in the stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          trio_pointer_t location;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The character currently being processed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          int current;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The number of characters that would have been written/read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│           * if there had been sufficient space.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          int processed;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          union {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                   * The number of characters that are actually written. Processed and                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                   * committed will only differ for the *nprintf functions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  int committed;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                   * The number of look-ahead characters read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  int cached;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          } actually;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The upper limit of characters that may be written/read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          int max;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           * The last output error that was detected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│           */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          int error;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  } trio_class_t;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │

│   *                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * Description:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│   *  Copies one trio_parameter_t struct to another.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  TRIO_PRIVATE void TrioCopyParameter TRIO_ARGS2((target, source), trio_parameter_t* target,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                 TRIO_CONST trio_parameter_t* source)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  #if TRIO_FEATURE_USER_DEFINED                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          size_t i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          target->type = source->type;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          target->flags = source->flags;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          target->width = source->width;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          target->precision = source->precision;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          target->base = source->base;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          target->baseSpecifier = source->baseSpecifier;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          target->varsize = source->varsize;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          target->beginOffset = source->beginOffset;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          target->endOffset = source->endOffset;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          target->position = source->position;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          target->data = source->data;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #if TRIO_FEATURE_USER_DEFINED                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          target->user_defined = source->user_defined;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          for (i = 0U; i < sizeof(target->user_data); ++i)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  if ((target->user_data[i] = source->user_data[i]) == NIL)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                          break;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
